evidence.rival_type: The party crosses the file opposite the player's latest build, so it reacts to the last move.
evidence.rival_tell: Two weeks of parties are shown with strength before the player acts; the file is derived from the mirror rule.
evidence.win_shape: Raise a den on all five files, then hold them through the Great Crossing with 18 Standing.
evidence.clock_shape: Fixed 16-week deadline; the week-9 step (tithe 2, +1 strength) is a one-off, not a per-turn growth.
evidence.ending_shape: Designed as a final roll, but in two of three games the Writ or a spare 27+ Standing made the last week a near-certain win.
evidence.decision_unit: Every build or snare takes a file letter; run and writ take none.
evidence.setting_family: Dens, herds, pilgrims and a stampede on a chessboard; nature documentary tone.
evidence.player_frame: A smuggler pawn who builds dens and runs contraband; operator rather than manager.
